description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 msbar: count times the block, codon (nucleic sequences) and point mutations of the lists are done at random places: insertions, deletions, changes, duplications and moves (1 = a random one of them, 0 = none; a comma list of at most 4); the result is tried again (10 times) when it equals a sequence of otherSequence. Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the output formats, the messages of the library; byte for byte). B09 WP62, F281.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file (any input format of seqret), or a sequence as letters.

count.description: The number of times the mutation operations are done (-count, default 1).

point.description: The point mutations (-point): 0 none, 1 any, 2 insertions, 3 deletions, 4 changes, 5 duplications, 6 moves; a comma list of at most 4 (default 0).

codon.description: The codon mutations (-codon), as point (default 0; nucleic sequences only).

inframe.description: Do the codon and block operations in frame (-inframe).

minimum.description: The minimum size of a block mutation (-minimum, default 1).

maximum.description: The maximum size of a block mutation (-maximum, default 10).

otherSequence.description: Sequences the result must not equal (-othersequence: the text of a sequence file, or a USA such as asis:ACGT).

microseconds.description: The microseconds of the clock when the random number generator is seeded (the seed is microseconds % 9999 + 1; the program takes them from the clock of the machine): the same value gives the same sequences. Default: the clock.

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat1); default: the program finds the format.

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1, -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 -scircular1, -sid1 name, -sdbname1 db, -squick1, -iquery1 query, -ioffset1 bytes.

outputFormat.description: The sequence output format (-osformat): fasta (default), embl, genbank, gcg, nbrf, ig, raw, msf, clustal, phylip, nexus, ... every format of seqret.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that the program may read (a file named by a USA, @file).

sequenceValue.description: The USA of the sequence input (-sequence) as the program reads it, instead of the text: [format::]file[begin:end:r], file:id, @list, asis::SEQUENCE.

text.description: The standard output of the program (the sequences) or the text of its output file.

files.description: The files the program wrote, by name.

messages.description: What the library printed on the error stream (warnings and errors).

errors.message: The program died: the messages of the library (a value it refuses, an input no reader reads, a sequence of the wrong kind)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

examples.name: A run on a small input
